editorial: In today's technology agenda, autonomous software agents and infrastructure tools for the development of these systems stand out. GitHub data shows that projects that automate complex task management and data set creation processes are gaining weight in the software development lifecycle.

items.title: usestrix/strix
items.summary: Strix is ​​an open source artificial intelligence-supported penetration testing tool developed to detect and fix security vulnerabilities in applications. This tool, written in Python language, aims to speed up vulnerability scanning processes by automating software security.

items.title: JuliusBrussee/caveman
items.summary: Caveman is a capability package developed for Claude Code that reduces token consumption by 65 percent by simplifying the language use of the artificial intelligence model. This tool aims to reduce processing costs by reducing complex commands to a primitive language structure.

items.title: msitarzewski/agency-agents
items.summary: The Agency-agents project offers an end-to-end digital agency workflow by bringing together artificial intelligence agents with different areas of expertise. It automates processes such as software development, content production and verification through specialized agents.

items.title: hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset
items.summary: This data set shared by Hasan Eyldrm presents 433 different fitness exercises with their names, target muscle groups, equipment and application instructions. This comprehensive dataset, supported by visual and video content, provides a structured resource for training health and sports-focused artificial intelligence models.

items.title: santifer/career-ops
items.summary: Using the Claude Code infrastructure, career-ops automates artificial intelligence-supported job search processes with 14 different skill modes. The system combines functions such as batch processing and resume creation in a single center via a Go-based control panel.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: Superpowers offers a framework and methodology that combines software development processes with agent-based skills. This structure creates a standardized workflow model for automating complex software tasks.

items.title: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
items.summary: Developed for Chrome DevTools, this server enables coding artificial intelligence agents to manage browser-based debugging processes. Working through the Model Context Protocol, this tool allows agents to directly inspect web applications and automate debugging processes.

items.title: browser-use/video-use
items.summary: The video-use library is a Python tool that allows coding agents to automate video editing processes. Thanks to this structure, developers can perform complex video editing operations using programmatic commands.

items.title: actions/checkout
items.summary: Developed by GitHub, actions/checkout is a tool that automates repository checkout processes in software development processes. Continuous integration enables the source code to be transferred to the working environment in workflows.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.summary: ECC offers a system that optimizes skills, memory and security layers for artificial intelligence coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor. Designed to increase agent performance in software development processes, this structure adopts a research-oriented development approach.

items.title: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
items.summary: Vibe-Trading is a personal trading agent that uses large language models to make trading decisions in financial markets. The project aims to execute automatic trading strategies on behalf of the user by analyzing market data.

items.title: agentskills/agentskills
items.summary: Agent Skills is a technical specification and documentation project that standardizes the skills used by artificial intelligence agents while performing their tasks. This Python-based structure aims to facilitate capability sharing and interoperability between different agent systems.

items.title: openai/codex-plugin-cc
items.summary: Developed by OpenAI, the Codex plugin is used on Claude Code to automate code review processes and provide task delegation. This tool allows the integration of different artificial intelligence models (large language models) in software development workflows.

items.title: langflow-ai/langflow
items.summary: Langflow is a Python-based development platform that offers a visual interface for building AI-powered agents and workflows. Users can design and deploy complex language model applications using drag-and-drop without writing code.

items.title: pytorch/pytorch
items.summary: PyTorch is a machine learning library that offers powerful graphics processing unit (GPU) acceleration for Python-based tensor calculations and dynamic neural networks. It provides broad ecosystem support in the development and deployment of deep learning models.

items.title: harvard-edge/cs249r_book
items.summary: This resource, shared by Harvard University, offers a comprehensive technical guide on machine learning systems. Combining hardware and software layers, this study addresses the design processes of scalable artificial intelligence infrastructures.

items.title: ryanmcdermott/clean-code-javascript
items.summary: This guide, which adapts clean code principles to the JavaScript language, offers standards for writing readable and maintainable code in software development processes. It combines object-oriented programming and functional programming principles with practical examples.

items.title: Virginia bans sale of geolocation data
items.summary: The state of Virginia has enacted a new regulation banning the marketing and sale of personal location data. This legal step limits the activities of third-party data brokers in order to protect consumers' digital privacy.

items.title: PeerTube is a free, decentralized and federated video platform
items.summary: PeerTube is an open source platform that offers an alternative to video hosting services with its decentralized and federated structure. It aims to distribute the bandwidth load and increase user control over content by using P2P (peer-to-peer) protocols.

items.title: Podman v6.0.0
items.summary: Podman v6.0.0 offers increased performance and expanded API support in container management processes. The new version provides a more stable infrastructure and advanced debugging tools for cloud-native workflows.

items.title: Since Linux 6.9, LUKS suspend stopped wiping disk-encryption keys from memory
items.summary: With Linux 6.9, the LUKS function, which allows disk encryption keys to be deleted from memory during suspend, has been disabled. This leaves devices vulnerable to physical memory attacks while in sleep mode.

items.title: The Free Market Lie: Why Switzerland Has 25 Gbit Internet and America Doesn't
items.summary: Switzerland's success in accessing high-speed internet infrastructure is based on infrastructure investments provided by local governments and public-oriented regulations, rather than free market competition. This situation calls into question the effectiveness of free market arguments in the telecommunications sector regarding broadband access.

items.title: empero-ai/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-GGUF
items.summary: Qwythos-9B is a multimodal artificial intelligence model that produces text output by processing visual and text data. The model offers the opportunity to analyze large data sets with a capacity of 1 million context windows.

items.title: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
items.summary: Unlimited-OCR, developed by Baidu, is a model that performs image-based text recognition (image-text-to-text) operations. It offers processing capacity by converting data in complex documents into text format.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2
items.summary: GLM-5.2, developed by Zai-org, is a language model designed for text generation tasks. This model, available on the HuggingFace platform, is optimized for use in content creation processes.

items.title: deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-35B-GGUF
items.summary: Ornith-1.0-35B, published by DeepReinforce-AI, is a language model focused on text generation. The model is presented in GGUF format to perform on complex tasks with a high number of parameters.

items.title: deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-9B-GGUF
items.summary: Ornith-1.0-9B, developed by DeepReinforce-AI, is a language model optimized for text generation tasks. The model is presented in GGUF format, which provides portable and efficient use.
